title: Instructor bookings (private store inputs/bookings.yaml)
description: What a calendar or travel tool exports for the staffing matching view (decision 0026): per booking, the instructor, a programme reference, the dates, the region and whether it means travel. Kept in the private store, read only by `teachermodel staffing-match`, never an event. The reference names a programme, never a client or a person.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, optionally with a subdivision, as in the staffing check
